subject: general
question: In which of the following does the river Godavari originate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmagiri hills**____**.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Godavari** is India's largest peninsular river.
 
• It is the second-longest river in India after the Ganga.
 
• It rises from **Maharashtra's Thriambak**** hill.**
 
• Its length is about **1500 km.**
 
• Due to its length and the area it covers, it is also known as the ‘**Dakshin Ganga**’.
 
• Flows through the states of** Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Purna, Pranhita, Indravati, and Sabari rivers are major left-bank tributaries.
 
• Pravara, Manjira, and Manair rivers are major right bank tributaries.
 
• The **Pranhita river** is Godavari's greatest tributary.
 
• Important dams built across the Godavari river:
 
 
• Jayakwadi dam.
 
• Gangapur Dam.
 
• Babli project.
 
• Sriram Sagar Dam.
 
 
 
• The** Coringa mangrove forest** is situated in the Godavari delta.
 
• The Godavari drains into the** Bay of Bengal.**
